# SavedConfigsManager

> **File:** `services/core/SavedConfigsManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Named snapshots of the config (one JSON file each in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/axiom/saved/) and shared configs: the examples shipped in examples/, imported files, exports to the home folder. axiom does the work (saved.* and share.*, backend/internal/saved): a snapshot holds the look, personal parts and commands (by the schema's x-scope) and the wallpaper setup (x-snapshot), in the export format, so a saved file can be shared or imported as it is; restoring applies it like an example, plus the wallpaper setup where its files are still there. Applying a shared file first saves the running config as "before-<name>". Files of any version axiom reads are taken (an older one is converted), and nothing loaded changes a takeover setting (x-takeover). This keeps what the settings page shows: the list, the active snapshot, a status line.

### Properties

- `savedDir` (readonly string)
- `examples` (readonly var): [{ name, title, description }] by name, from examples/*.json
- `model` (readonly FolderListModel): Newest first; roles: fileBaseName, filePath, fileModified
- `status` (string): Last save/restore/delete outcome, for the settings UI
- `active` (readonly string): The saved config the running one was last saved as or restored from, "" for none (or once its file is gone): the one the settings UI offers to overwrite
- `modified` (readonly bool): Whether the running config's snapshot parts differ from the active saved one's (machine settings, which restoring doesn't change, are left out)
- `activeSource` (readonly string): The shared setup the active saved config was saved from, unchanged since: "" for one the user saved, or saved over
- `importing` (var): An imported file awaiting confirmation: { name, title, description, path, hasPersonal, hasCommands } (hasPersonal: the file holds preferences, keybinds or apps; hasCommands: commands), or null
- `picking` (readonly bool): The file picker is open

### Signals

- `applied(string name)`: An example, import or shared setup was applied as `name` (its backup is "before-<name>"), or failed to be (status says why).
- `applyFailed(string name)`

### Functions

- `sanitize(name)`
- `exists(name)`
- `save(name)`: Saves the running config's snapshot parts under `name`, replacing any existing snapshot of that name.
- `restore(name)`
- `restoreDefaults()`: Applies the schema defaults like an example (the look, personal parts and commands; machine settings stay), after saving the running config as "before-defaults"
- `applyExample(name)`: Applies an example's look, after saving the running config as "before-<name>"
- `browseImport()`: Opens the desktop's file picker; the chosen file goes to openImport
- `openImport(path)`: Reads a shared file (an export, an example, or a whole config.json of any version) as `importing`, for the settings page to confirm
- `confirmImport(personal, commands)`: Applies `importing` (its personal parts too when `personal`: preferences, keybinds, apps; its commands when `commands`), after saving the running config as "before-<name>"
- `cancelImport()`
- `applyShared(name, path, title, snapshot)`: Applies a shared file at `path` straight away, its look only, after saving the running config as "before-<name>", then saves the result as `snapshot`: a community setup (CommunitySetupsManager).
- `exportConfig(personal, commands, places = true)`: Writes the running config's look (and its personal parts when `personal`, its commands when `commands`) to ~/axiom-<name>-<date>-<time>.json, holding only what differs from the defaults: a file to sh…
- `remove(name)`
